question: Should Signal permanently support per-account apiMode overrides while native existing-server setup proves daemon/RPC reachability and container setup additionally proves linked-account receive readiness?
rationale: The patch can implement either policy correctly, but repository tests cannot decide the durable configuration, upgrade, and operator-support contract.

options.title: Accept expanded contract
options.body: Keep per-account overrides and document the intentionally different native and container readiness guarantees.

options.title: Narrow configuration scope
options.body: Land the guided setup without account-level apiMode and defer mixed-transport accounts to separately approved work.

options.title: Require uniform receive proof
options.body: Make setup block for both transports until the selected account's receive path is positively verified.

recommendation.title: Accept expanded contract
recommendation.body: Keep per-account overrides and document the intentionally different native and container readiness guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged history spans every central Signal surface involved in this product-contract choice.
